name: OvertChat
description: A clean self-hosted chat for your local AI models, with search, voice and family accounts

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with every account, chat, project and file, and .better_auth_secret, this install's own sign-in key made on first start. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OvertChat web app and API, published on host as 6139

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.description: The address you open OvertChat at. Sign-in already works from your home network at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6139, so you can leave it. Change it to your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6139, for working share links, or to your https address behind a reverse proxy.
